My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m really sorry to hear that one of your items didn’t arrive in good shape. I know that’s disappointing after waiting for your plants.
Here’s what we should do next so our team can review this for you:
Please share:
Your email address
Your order number (or your full name and shipping address if you don’t have the order number handy)
The name of the item that arrived damaged
Photos:
A clear photo of the damaged plant or product
A photo of the full box
A close-up of any visible damage to the packaging
You can attach the photos right here in chat. If you’re not able to provide photos, just let me know.
Once you send that information, I’ll pass everything along to our team so they can review what happened and be in touch with next steps.
